what: Time to a relative-L2 target of the pre-registered end-to-end suite v2 with Addendum A and Amendment B (13 JAX problems, float64 and float32 at matmul precision highest): the strongest omnibias pair (Adam or L-BFGS with the projected, omnibias or planned_find engine; Gauss-Newton, SPRING, trust-region Levenberg-Marquardt, ENGD or KFAC with the structured Gram) against the strongest baseline pair (jet, nested autodiff, folx, sparse folx, dense, Hutchinson, SDGD, STDE and the explicit-Jacobian optimizers), per target and per treatment of the compile time. A target that no Adam grid point reached in the reachability stage is not eligible and is incomplete here, not a ratio
hardware: one exclusive NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB per problem, five seeds per pair
protocol: ratio = baseline time / omnibias time, geometric mean over five seeds; lower = exp(mean log r - t(0.95, 4) sd / sqrt 5), upper = ratio^2 / lower; both pairs are the lowest-median pairs among those that reached the target in every seed, selected on the seeds that are compared (which favours the baseline when the choice is noisy); a target that no pair reached in every seed, that the reachability stage marks not eligible, or that no baseline reached is incomplete, not a ratio. Suite v2 problem sizes differ from suite v1's, so these cells are not pooled with the v1 record
